purpose: Teach: レーン/バラード/アサ/ファイア/台場/ハロ/冴え/エッジ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ボーリングのレーン、本気で、絶対、彼と、絶対、行きたいよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、楽しい、絶対、本気、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: Aoi, you really want to go bowling with him, don't you? It would be so much fun.
lines.style: Bright, conspiratorial opening. Rushes slightly with excitement. Warm and inviting, like pulling her friend into a shared wish. Ends on a soft lift.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。バラードの曲、本気で、葵で、絶対、流すと、お客様、本気で、絶対、ロマンチック、感じてくれるわよ、メイちゃん、本気、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yeah. When you play a ballad at the café, customers really do feel that romantic vibe, you know? They get it.
lines.style: Cheerful and knowing. Quick rhythm, like she's sharing a secret she's observed a hundred times. Light, conversational. Slight proud edge about her café.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祭りで、本気で、絶対、アサヒの花火、絶対、楽しんだよね、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感動した、本気で、本気、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Remember the fireworks at the festival with Aoi? The Asahi display was so beautiful. I was really moved.
lines.style: Wistful, nostalgic. Softer pace. Voice drifts slightly, caught in the memory. Warm underneath, tender on the trailing word.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏の、本気で、絶対、ファイアダンス、葵で、絶対、見学したわよ、メイちゃん、本気で、本当に、感動
lines.en: And that fire dance performance in summer — we went to see it together. I still remember how amazing it was.
lines.style: Animated with genuine recall. Speaking a bit faster, caught up in the moment. Warm and inclusive — 'we' lands gently. Eyes lit up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お台場、本気で、絶対、行ったわよ、彼と、メイちゃん、葵、本気で、絶対、楽しかった、本気で、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: We went to Odaiba with him too, remember? That was such a good day. So much fun.
lines.style: Eager and forward-reaching. Opens with energy. Slight emphasis on the shared memory. Warm and inclusive throughout. Ends with quiet contentment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ハロウィン、本気で、絶対、葵で、特別なイベント、絶対、企画してるのよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、来てね、本気で、本気、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: For Halloween, I'm actually planning something special at the café. You have to come, okay?
lines.style: Eager with a touch of gentle insistence. Leans in on the invitation. Quick tempo, genuinely excited. The 'you have to come' is affectionate, not demanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、最近、本気で、絶対、冴え冴えとした、判断、絶対、お見事ね、メイちゃん、本気で、感心、本気で、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: You've been making such sharp calls lately, Aoi. Your judgment is really impressive.
lines.style: Praising and sincere. Slower, deliberate pace — each word lands. Genuine admiration underneath. Quiet respect in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵の店、本気で、絶対、エッジの効いた、デザイン、絶対、本気で、お洒落、メイちゃん、本気で、感心、本気で、本気、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: The way you've styled your café is so clever. It has real edge to it, real taste. I really admire it.
lines.style: Cheerful close with underlying warmth. Conversational tempo. Pride in her friend lives in the voice. Ends gently — not gushing, just genuine.
